summary: T1 item 8: sim/CHARACTERIZATION.md is the one aggregated, current, per-spec-row rollup for this block, and it names the sim/<slug>/records/ evidence record behind every verdict. It is generated (sim/build_characterization_report.py), never hand-edited, and CI regenerates and diffs it on every push, so it cannot drift from the committed evidence. Item 8 asks for the aggregation artifact to exist and be current, not for every row to pass: this report currently reads FAIL on PSRR, MIXED on Startup, and marks most rows' underlying sim record STALE against the current design/netlist/*.spice. Those are item 5's gap, tracked there as unmet, not item 8's. Current limit and Thermal read PASS as of issue #139's re-run against DR-0005's ratified 62-95 mA / <= 346 mW rows (they read FAIL while the head record was still graded against the superseded 65-80 mA / <= 290 mW ones). Stability reads PASS against the DR-0018-ratified envelope (issue #276), with the wider DR-0001 full-matrix result shown alongside rather than driving the verdict. See signoff/README.md for the full reading. PSRR reads FAIL as of issue #289's re-run: sim/psrr-vs-freq and sim/psrr-vs-freq-50ma both fail the ratified > 50 dB @ 1 kHz row at 3 of 45 corners (worst 29.4268 dB at ff_125c_3.63v), superseding a stale PASS pair taken 2026-09-05. Root cause and why no sizing lever closes it: spec/decision-records/DR-0031. That is a real design gap, surfaced by the rollup rather than hidden by it -- which is the property item 8 grades; the gap itself is tracked as issue #302. Issue #279 / DR-0033's resistor-flavour swap moved the DUT netlist sha, so every record taken before it is stale against it: loop-stability, amp-openloop, amp-selfosc, psrr-dc, psrr-vs-freq, psrr-vs-freq-50ma, quiescent-current and dropout-vs-load are re-minted there and read fresh; current-limit is not (its record is hand-written), so Current limit and Thermal read STALE again, with the bench re-run and reproducing bit-identically. The PSRR verdict is unchanged by that swap -- the re-minted pair fails at the same three corners, marginally better at every one. Issue #294 / DR-0033's successor DR-0034 widened the pass device from 2 mm to 2.8 mm, which moves the DUT netlist sha again: loop-stability, dropout-vs-load, quiescent-current and current-limit are re-minted against the 2.8 mm device and read fresh (Current limit and Thermal read fresh for the first time since the row was hand-written), while the PSRR pair and psrr-dc's siblings go stale against it -- the PSRR verdict itself is unchanged and still FAIL per DR-0031. Stability still reads PASS against the DR-0018-ratified envelope, 630/630 at 48.65 deg / 11.21 dB; the wider DR-0001 window it is shown alongside degrades from 2974/4536 to 2790/4536, which is outside the ratified envelope and not what this row grades. Issue #304 re-mints sim/psrr-vs-freq alone against the 2.8 mm device (record 20260923-233113-1a8fcf7), so that row reads fresh again while psrr-vs-freq-50ma stays stale against it; the PSRR verdict is unchanged -- still FAIL at the same three corners, worst 29.4286 dB at ff_125c_3.63v -- and the harness-integrity checks (dc_vout_v, dc_iload_ma) now pass at all 45 corners, including the fs_125c_3.63v sub-ground state #304 characterised as a false convergence rather than a second solution. Issue #325 adds the missing vout-range half of that discriminator to sim/line-regulation and sim/load-regulation and re-mints both against the current (DR-0034, 2.8 mm) device: load-regulation reads PASS 81/81 and fresh; line-regulation reads FAIL and fresh, at 1 of 27 corners -- ff_125c_3.30v, 8.2345 mV/V at 1 mA and 8.23715 mV/V at 50 mA against the ratified < 5 mV/V row -- which also flips the Output row from PASS to FAIL, since line regulation is counted inside its +/-2% window. That verdict is not damage done by #325's wording change: the record it supersedes was taken 2026-09-05 against a pre-DR-0033/DR-0034 netlist and read STALE, and the failing corner plus the next-worst one (ff_125c, sf_125c at 2.91 mV/V) are exactly the corners DR-0031 root-causes to the soft-start FB-injection element's supply-dependent settled residual (112.5 nA/V, 33 mV/V at VOUT through Rtop = 300 kOhm) -- the defect tracked as issue #302, whose acceptance set names only the PSRR decks today. Both decks' harness-integrity checks, the new vout_* bounds included, PASS at every corner, so this is a regulation error and not a sub-ground root. Issue #259 / DR-0028 gates the soft-start FB-injection transconductor's degeneration-branch supply off the mirror's own reference node, which moves the DUT netlist sha again, so sim/loop-stability is re-minted against the gated device (record 20260925-000348-c76efb0) and the Stability row reads PASS and fresh; every other row goes stale against it, which is item 5's standing gap and not item 8's. Stability is unchanged in substance -- still PASS against the DR-0018-ratified envelope at 630/630, worst PM 48.65 deg / worst GM 11.20 dB (was 11.21 dB), DR-0008 resurgence 0/630 -- and the wider DR-0001 window it is shown alongside moves 2790/4536 to 2791/4536, one point better, which is outside the ratified envelope and not what this row grades. That the gating barely touches the loop is the expected result and not an absence of measurement: this bench measures the settled operating point, which is exactly where DR-0028's mechanism has already switched the element's branches off. The same issue also re-mints sim/quiescent-current against the gated device (record 20260925-002900-c76efb0), and that row goes from PASS/stale to UNKNOWN/fresh: 80 of the 81 points pass with the recovery DR-0028 claims intact at the binding ff_125c_3.63v corner (iq_en_ua 27.3882 -> 22.2696, iq_full_ua 28.7153 -> 23.7329 against main's ungated netlist on the same host, so 1.28 -> 6.27 uA of headroom on the binding full-load clause), but the 81st, ss_-40c_2.97v, exhausts ngspice's DC continuation ladder and falls to the pseudo-transient rung, which issue #310's gate refuses to accept as an operating point, so the record grades Overall: ERROR and the row cannot read PASS. UNKNOWN is the correct reading of that and is left standing rather than papered over: main's ungated netlist solves the same corner 81/81 on the same host, so the gate causes it. DR-0028 section 6 records the discriminator -- with .options noopiter the same deck reaches the physical root (8.8991333574 uA, matching main's 8.89913 to six digits), so this is a ladder that does not reach an existing solution, not an absent solution, and the fix belongs in the runner rather than in DR-0028's sizing.
